CREATE TABLE `all_types_test` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `col_tinyint` tinyint(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_smallint` smallint(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_mediumint` mediumint(9) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_int` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_bigint` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_float` float DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_double` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_decimal` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_time` time DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_datetime` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_timestamp` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_year` year(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_char` char(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_varchar` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_text` text,
  `col_blob` blob,
  `col_enum` enum('active','inactive','pending') DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_set` set('read','write','execute') DEFAULT NULL,
  `col_bit` bit(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1 ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC
